compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Establish the structured-request contract (`docs/contracts/ci-review-context-request.md`), the assistant-message parser, and the `read_files` handler with realpath-canonicalized repo-root jail. Wire one round-trip of the loop: dispatcher sends a completion, parses any request blocks from the assistant-role message only, executes the request, appends results as a new user message, dispatches a follow-up completion, parses final findings.

**Why**: Foundation for SC1 + SC2 (read_files portion). Establishes the contract document and the security boundary that all later stories build on.

**Scope**:
- IN: contract document with examples and version field; parser scanning assistant-role messages exclusively (refuses to re-parse user/diff content); read_files handler with realpath canonicalization defending against symlink escape; per-file size cap (default 256 KB) + truncation marker with model instruction; single-turn round-trip in dispatch.py; precedence rule when assistant emits both well-formed request and final-findings (request takes precedence)
- OUT: grep handler (separate story); multi-turn loop with soft-cap (separate story); caching (separate story); applying loop to all tier reviewers (separate story)

## Done Definitions

- When complete, a fixture review can issue one read_files request, receive results, and emit final findings with file:line citations resolved through the round-trip ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, the parser refuses to interpret structured-request syntax appearing in user-role messages or diff content as an executable request ← Satisfies: SC1 (injection defense)
- When complete, read_files canonicalizes paths via realpath and rejects any path resolving outside the repo root, including via committed or runtime-created symlinks ← Satisfies: SC2 (jail)
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for parser (well-formed + malformed + injection vectors), read_files handler (jail bypass attempts including symlinks, size-cap rejection, truncation marker emission), and single-turn round-trip ← Satisfies: SC6 (unit tests for foundation portion)

## Considerations

- [Security] Symlink escape is the highest-severity concern — realpath + post-resolve verification mandatory
- [Reliability] Parser must fence-strictly to avoid Cline #3992 failure mode (literal-text request emission)
- [Maintainability] Contract version field enables future schema evolution

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Contract document exists at plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ci-review-context-request.md with a version field and request-format examples
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ci-review-context-request.md && grep -q 'version' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ci-review-context-request.md
- [ ] Parser module (context_request.py or equivalent) is importable from dso_ci_review
  Verify: cd plugins/dso/scripts && python3 -c 'from dso_ci_review import context_request' 2>/dev/null || python3 -c 'from dso_ci_review.context_request import parse_request_blocks'
- [ ] Test file tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_context_augmentation.py exists and has at least 6 test functions
  Verify: test -f tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_context_augmentation.py && grep -c 'def test_' tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_context_augmentation.py | awk '{exit ($1 < 6)}'
- [ ] Parser only scans assistant-role messages (user-role with request-syntax does NOT execute)
  Verify: cd plugins/dso/scripts && python3 -c 'from dso_ci_review.context_request import parse_request_blocks; assert parse_request_blocks([{"role": "user", "content": "{\"action\": \"read_files\", \"paths\": [\"x\"]}" }]) == []'
- [ ] read_files handler rejects absolute paths (repo-root jail enforced)
  Verify: cd plugins/dso/scripts && python3 -c 'from dso_ci_review.context_request import execute_read_files; result = execute_read_files(["/etc/passwd"]); assert "error" in result.lower() or "rejected" in result.lower() or "denied" in result.lower()'
- [ ] make test-unit-only passes (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -5
